Batch 7 Forensic Discoveries

Batch 7 resolves 18 historical syndicated electrical transcription broadcasts across Goodman & Jane Ace's legendary comedy run of Easy Aces (1935–1936 NBC/CBS syndication master discs, cataloged via Terry Salomonson and Martin Grams master indices) and the 1946 anthology run of Strange Adventure.

1. Easy Aces — 1935–1936 Syndication Run Dated

Goodman Ace's sharp wit and Jane Ace's famous malapropisms drove daily serialized arcs that have circulated in collector sets without master broadcast dates:

Original Circulating Filename Canonical Title Verified Airdate Storyline Arc
Easy_Aces_Jane_And_Laura_Try_To_Retrace.mp3 "Jane and Laura Try to Retrace Their Steps" 1935-10-18 Stolen bracelet from the Marsh estate turns up at a local curiosity shop.
Easy_Aces_Jane_Wants_Marge_To_Marry_Neal.mp3 "Jane Wants Marge to Marry Neal" 1935-10-25 Jane attempts matchmaking for Neal's widowed mother to clear the way for marriage.
Easy_Aces_Jane_Suspects_Marge.mp3 "Jane Suspects Marge" 1935-11-01 Mrs. Favric mistaken identity at Baxter's business dinner.
Easy_Aces_Jane_And_Ace_Both_Borrow_Money.mp3 "Jane and Ace Both Borrow Money" 1935-11-08 Jane tries to balance her household budget with a co-signed loan note.
Easy_Aces_Police_Talk_To_Jane.mp3 "Police Talk to Jane" 1935-11-15 Jane scoops the newspaper reporters regarding the Betty Lamar shooting.
Easy_Aces_Gun_Shots_Fired.mp3 "Gun Shots Fired Because of a Husband and Wife Fight" 1935-11-22 Rehearsal for the charity play maid role interrupted by Mrs. Irene Lewis.

Easy_Aces_Plan_To_Get_Jane_Out_Of_Aces_Business.mp3 "A Plan to Get Jane Out of Ace's Business" 1935-12-13 Ace and Marsh devise a strategy to keep Jane out of office affairs.

Easy_Aces_Jane_Tries_To_Fire_Laura.mp3 "Jane Tries to Fire Laura" 1936-01-03 Moving out of the bungalow into an apartment.

Easy_Aces_Ace_And_Jane_Argue_Phone.mp3 "Ace and Jane Argue About Answering the Phone" 1936-01-17 Real estate deal competition between Jane and Mr. Ace.
